لَكَثٌ and ↓ لُكَاثٌ (as also نُكَاثٌ, TA,) A disorder in the mouths of camels, resembling pustules. (Lh, K.) ―
-b2- ↓ لُكَاثَةٌ , A disorder that attacks sheep or goats in the sides of the mouth and in the lips, resembling an ulcer; happening on their first cropping plants when they are short, with small branches. (L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
